verdict.rationale: The only relevant evidence is a single line on the docs landing page. It says a built-in Mission Control Agent can investigate the user's CoreWeave environment and make 'supported changes', which is a direct but very thinly documented form of in-product task delegation. The 'supported changes' wording implies the agent can only act within a limited scope. missing for 10: in-depth docs on what tasks can be delegated and how the agent is invoked in the Cloud Console, the scope of supported changes and approval controls, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product

citations.quote: Mission Control Agent and the Mission Control MCP server for investigating your environment and making supported changes.
